list.name: repository
list.label: Repository
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT repository FROM runs ORDER BY repository

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, COUNT(*) AS "open" FROM v_run_suggestions WHERE started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND repository IN ($repository) AND CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'major' THEN 1 WHEN 'minor' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END <= $severity

SELECT NOW() AS time, COALESCE(SUM(saving_kwh), 0) AS "saveable" FROM v_run_suggestions WHERE started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND repository IN ($repository) AND CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'major' THEN 1 WHEN 'minor' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END <= $severity

SELECT NOW() AS time, COALESCE(SUM(saving_gco2eq), 0) AS "saveable" FROM v_run_suggestions WHERE started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND repository IN ($repository) AND CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'major' THEN 1 WHEN 'minor' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END <= $severity

SELECT NOW() AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT repository) AS "repos" FROM v_run_suggestions WHERE started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND repository IN ($repository) AND CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'major' THEN 1 WHEN 'minor' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END <= $severity

panels.title: Top suggestions by potential gCO₂eq saved (sum over period)

targets.rawSql: SELECT suggestion_id || ' [' || severity || ']' AS metric, SUM(saving_gco2eq) AS value FROM v_run_suggestions WHERE started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND repository IN ($repository) AND CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'major' THEN 1 WHEN 'minor' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END <= $severity GROUP BY suggestion_id, severity ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT severity AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM v_run_suggestions WHERE started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND repository IN ($repository) AND CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'major' THEN 1 WHEN 'minor' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END <= $severity GROUP BY severity ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'major' THEN 1 WHEN 'minor' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

SELECT repository, COUNT(*) AS suggestions, SUM(saving_kwh) AS save_kwh, SUM(saving_gco2eq) AS save_gco2eq FROM v_run_suggestions WHERE started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND repository IN ($repository) AND CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'major' THEN 1 WHEN 'minor' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END <= $severity GROUP BY repository ORDER BY save_gco2eq DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT started_at, repository, workflow, severity, suggestion_id, title, saving_kwh AS save_kwh, saving_gco2eq AS save_gco2eq, detail FROM v_run_suggestions WHERE started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND repository IN ($repository) AND CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'major' THEN 1 WHEN 'minor' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END <= $severity ORDER BY started_at DESC, CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'major' THEN 1 WHEN 'minor' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, saving_gco2eq DESC LIMIT 200
